dedupe_keys.name: uk pollutant release and transfer register uk prtr data sets facility emissions and waste transfers

description: The UK register of pollutants released by industrial facilities and of their waste transfers. The Defra guidance page says the UK PRTR implements the Kiev Protocol on PRTRs and UK PRTR legislation, covers activities listed in Annex I, and holds for each facility its parent company, location including the river basin, activity, pollutant or waste, the medium (air, water, land) of each release, off-site transfers of waste and their destination, and off-site transfers of pollutants in wastewater, with codes for how values were measured, calculated or estimated. The page, last updated on 30 June 2026, says the register is moving to a new system and that meanwhile the industrial emissions data can be downloaded in CSV and XML formats; page content is under the Open Government Licence v3.0 and is free. Coverage is the United Kingdom, one row per facility, pollutant and year. Caveats: reporting thresholds leave out small releases, and the system is being replaced. For simulation it locates industrial sites with their pollutants and waste flows, to estimate what a flood or fire at a site could release. A related catalogue record is the European Industrial Emissions Portal.
